content.introduction: The sources describe an earnings calendar as a tool that tracks earnings report dates for publicly traded companies worldwide, displaying EPS and Revenue forecasts alongside actual results. The Investing.com Earnings Calendar helps users compare analyst expectations with reported outcomes. The Markets Insider Earnings Calendar allows tracking of companies releasing earnings reports and sorting by market cap. The Zacks Investment Research Earnings Calendar provides a schedule of when companies report their financial results, serving as a strategic investing tool to prepare for volatility, compare expectations vs. reality, and monitor post-earnings reactions. body:
## FAQ

### What is the Investing.com Earnings Calendar?

The Earnings Calendar is a free tool that tracks earnings report dates for publicly traded companies worldwide. It displays EPS and Revenue forecasts alongside actual results once released, so you can compare analyst expectations with reported outcomes in a single view.

### What is an earnings surprise? [...] Most publicly traded companies report earnings four times a year, once per fiscal quarter. Earnings season typically begins a few weeks after each quarter ends, with the busiest reporting periods falling in January, April, July, and October. Not all companies report on the same date, so the Earnings Calendar helps you track which companies are reporting on any given day.

### How do I filter the Earnings Calendar? [...] An earnings surprise occurs when a company's reported EPS or Revenue differs from the analyst consensus forecast. A positive surprise means the company outperformed expectations, while a negative surprise means it underperformed. The Earnings Calendar displays this as the EPS Surprise % and Revenue Surprise % columns, making it easy to spot which companies beat or missed forecasts at a glance.

## About the earnings calendar

The Markets Insider Earnings Calendar offers you the ability to track companies who are releasing earnings reports. Use the customizable earnings calendar to learn when a public company will announce their quarterly or annual earnings.

The earnings calendar allows you to sort earnings by market cap, deep dive on estimates and learn historical data for your favorite stocks. [...] Use the earnings calendar to get latest earnings news and earnings reports results. Including the latest earnings live blogs and post earnings analysis. Bookmark the Markets Insider earnings calendar to keep up to date with the latest earnings reports for the companies you care about.
